name: outatime
author: LizardMan
description: Every voice plays three oscillators, the flux capacitor's three arms. Year picks their wave and Speed lets them drift through the years around it. Power is a strong overdrive, and Trail is the ignition: each note opens a resonant filter that then burns down. The amp envelope on T2, glide and the play modes work as on the other synths. Push blue, green or white for page 2.
